label: Bible Study
prompt: And whatsoever ye do, do it _____, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verse: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
note: 'Heartily' — the KJV's word for doing Monday's work as if it were for the Lord.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For where two or three are _____ together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verse: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
note: No minimum attendance for the presence of Christ — two or three will do fine.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Give therefore thy servant an _____ heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
verse: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
note: Offered anything, Solomon asked for an understanding heart — the request that pleased God.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And beside this, giving all _____, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
verse: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
note: Peter's growth ladder starts with effort: grace is free, but the climbing takes all diligence.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For there is one God, and one _____ between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verse: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
note: One God, one 'mediator' — the go-between. The word every communion meditation leans on.
